# marble 6.18 KMI/ABI Baseline Manifest

**Generated by:** `tools/generate_marble_kmi_baseline.sh`

## Scope

This is a reproducible, text-only baseline for the current marble 6.18 diagnostic build. It identifies the configuration, module-symbol table, and vendor-gap audit inputs that future source-built vendor modules must be compared against. It is not an Android GKI certification, an approved product KMI, or proof that any 5.10 vendor binary can load on 6.18.

The audited first-stage module-name gap contains `97` entries. The vendor-load module-name gap contains `285` entries. These are name-level lower bounds; symbol, firmware, Device Tree, ramdisk, and userspace dependencies are separate work items.

## Acceptance rule for future vendor modules

Every candidate 6.18 vendor module must be source-built against this frozen baseline or a deliberately revised successor. It must have reviewed configuration, matching vermagic/modversion semantics, approved exported-symbol dependencies, a load-order and firmware plan, and a driver contract. A 5.10 binary, or a module matched only by filename, is rejected.
